categories.name: Chicken Cuts (Protein)
categories.unit: grams protein per lb (raw, as purchased)

formula.description: Given item A priced at price_A per lb, the equivalent price for item B (same value per dollar) is: price_B = price_A * (value_per_lb_B / value_per_lb_A)

variables.price_A: known price per lb of the anchor item
variables.value_per_lb_A: metric value per lb of the anchor item (calories or protein grams)
variables.value_per_lb_B: metric value per lb of the comparison item
variables.price_B: the price per lb at which item B delivers equal value-per-dollar as item A
